req.title: Task has default completed=false
req.statement: The system shall default the completed field to false when POST /tasks/ omits it.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-016 requires that POST /tasks/ defaults completed=false when the field is omitted. Three test cases are designed: (1) positive EP test — omit 'completed' entirely, assert response is 201 and completed==false; (2) negative NEG test — explicitly send completed=true to confirm the field is NOT defaulted when provided (distinguishes default logic from forced override); (3) boundary DT test — send a minimal payload with only 'title' (no description, no completed) to confirm the schema default fires at the absolute minimum valid input boundary, and also verify that sending completed=false explicitly yields the same result as omitting it (boolean invariant both sides). Each test uses an in-memory SQLite DB via dependency override so it is isolated, deterministic, and idempotent.

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

def test_post_task_omit_completed_defaults_to_false():
    engine = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    TestingSession = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
    def override_get_db():
        db = TestingSession()
        try:
            yield db
        finally:
            db.close()
    app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {"title": "Test default completed", "description": "Some description"}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert body["completed"] is False
    assert body["title"] == "Test default completed"
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    app.dependency_overrides.clear()

test_post_task_omit_completed_defaults_to_false()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

def test_post_task_minimal_payload_title_only_completed_defaults_false():
    engine = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    TestingSession = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
    def override_get_db():
        db = TestingSession()
        try:
            yield db
        finally:
            db.close()
    app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
    client = TestClient(app)
    r1 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "A"})
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    b1 = r1.json()
    assert b1["completed"] is False
    assert b1["completed"] == False
    assert b1["title"] == "A"
    r2 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "B", "completed": False})
    assert r2.status_code == 201
    b2 = r2.json()
    assert b2["completed"] is False
    assert b2["completed"] == False
    r3 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": ""})
    assert r3.status_code == 422
    app.dependency_overrides.clear()
